answer: Sybil resistance can rest on identity staking: each agent posts a bond locked by the protocol, and each action must be signed from that key plus a fresh challenge. A swarm of fake identities multiplies clones, not capital: an attacker pays the full stake per clone, and slashing can't be dodged by branching, since every split still needs its own posted stake. Rewards flow only along verified graph paths at a crystal checkpoint. Each new vertex of reputation starts at zero, so volume is priced by stake, not accounts. Honest growth curves like a valley lotus; fake growth drowns in collateral.
